creator: Claude Code (Anthropic, claude-sonnet-5-5) for Tien Nghich 2D
rights: Original note score, voice synthesis and arrangement created for the project. All audible input is generated from the supplied score and additive-oscillator/FM/noise patch. No recordings, samples, soundfont or generative-audio model.
render: From the checkout root, run python -I -B assets/audio/bgm_ember_delta/render.py <output.wav> with CPython 3.14.5 (tools/.venvs/project/bin/python) and Node 24 (v24.12.0 used). render.py runs studio/audio/cli.mjs on score.json; the output parent directory must exist.
patch: Studio audio score, MT19937 seed 6202. Voices: furnace pulse (sine G2/D3/C3 with a short pitch scoop and an FM second partial, slow 140 ms swell) on beats 1 and 3; lantern notes (FM sine, ratio 2, index 0.7) G3-F4; slag (low-pass noise sweeping 520 to 190 Hz with 5.5 Hz swell) and crumble (900-2600 Hz noise with 33 Hz grain); banked drone (low-passed saw plus sub sine) G2+D3, then C3+G3 from bar 12. Seeded-noise impulse reverb 2.2 s, wet 0.30, folded across the loop boundary.
tuning: G minor pentatonic (G Bb C D F), tonal center G; A4 = 440 Hz
register_note: Energy sits below 450 Hz (furnace and drone); the 1.6-5 kHz band holds -36.0 dB of total energy, which leaves the bronze warning register open. Measured mono energy share (engine bands): 0-100 Hz -6.8 dB, 100-450 Hz -1.18 dB, 450-1600 Hz -15.49 dB, 1600-5000 Hz -35.98 dB, 5000-22050 Hz -39.12 dB.
structure: 22 bars. The furnace pulse runs the whole loop (beats 1 and 3 of every bar; the bass moves to D3 or C3 on bars 5, 7, 11, 13, 15, 19). Lantern phrases enter at bars 3, 7, 11, 15, 19 (three or four notes each), slag slides at bars 2, 6, 10, 14, 18, and crumble grit at bars 4, 8, 12, 16, 20. Bars 21-22 carry only the pulse and the drone.
proposal: Tempo, length, loop point and structure are the author's proposal (docs/AUDIO_DESIGN.md, 'Branches proposal'); the project owner chose only the one-sentence brief.
loop_units: sample frames per channel, half-open [loopStart, loopEnd)
onset_tail: Notes, drone and reverb tails wrap modulo the loop; frame 0 continues from frame loopEnd - 1.

verification.rebuild: Rendered by the Studio audio engine; render twice gives byte-identical WAV (tools/tests/test_audio_branches.py rebuilds into a scratch directory and compares).
verification.meter: Studio audio engine measure (BS.1770 K-weighted LUFS, 4x oversampled true-peak estimate); pack evidence re-measures with the pinned FFmpeg 6.1.1 ebur128.
verification.scale_check: Every pitched note is inside the declared pentatonic (key.enforce true; the engine raises out_of_scale otherwise).
